---
title: "multised (clean analyses)"
subtitle: "Analyses on the QC-passed marine-sediment databases"
---

The **clean** databases are the QC-passed, uniformly formatted end product of the
**multised** slim phase: five per-source databases of harmonised trace-element
chemistry, with grain-size in its own tables. How they are built (harmonisation,
cleaning, and the grain-size split) is documented on the
[slim site](https://seafood-hazards.github.io/multised-slim/), under **Clean
databases**.

This site presents the **analyses performed on** those clean databases. Planned
work (see the project roadmap):

```{r}
library(tibble)
library(knitr)

tribble(
  ~Analysis,                        ~Status,
  "Iron / aluminium normalisation", "planned",
  "Grain-size distribution analysis","planned",
  "Cross-source merge into one database","planned",
  "Background and pristine sediment definition","planned"
) |> kable()
```

::: {.callout-note}
Results will be added here as each analysis is completed. The pages read the clean
databases live at render time.
:::
